name: 2345看图王 (2345 Pic / Kantu Wang)
vendor: 上海二三四五移动科技有限公司 (2345.com)
price: Free viewer; VIP membership for editing/AI/PDF extras (monthly, yearly, lifetime)
last_update: 2025-09-30 (Tencent store entry for v13.2; site articles to 2026-10)
summary: One of the most installed Windows picture viewers in China: opens about 98 image formats including PSD, RAW, SVG and AVIF quickly, plus PDF/OFD and CAD. It bundles light editing, batch tools, OCR, ID photos and AI cutout, some of them behind a VIP membership.
where_it_wins: Very wide image format list (PSD/PSB, AI, RAW, CAD, OFD)
Built-in editing, batch convert/rename, OCR, ID-photo and printing tools
Familiar to Chinese Windows users, ACDSee-compatible shortcuts
where_schnellbild_wins: Runs on the Mac at all (no Mac version)
No ads, software recommendations, homepage lock or usage data collection
Plays videos (MP4, MKV, AVI, WebM) in the same grid
Archives and comics as folders, dual pane, recursive name and regex search
Free with every feature, open source
